Bettina, I saved a mail draft to June Osei-Lark (joseilark@pemberline.com) with the subject "PHL label cleanup." It includes Sofia's two facts and your two lines: Pellucid rows are the Gulf Coast terminal rows, and Pellow rows are the Mid-Atlantic home goods appointments.

The earlier draft to June still has the third bullet I added, which Sofia didn't write. I can't edit or delete drafts, so Sofia will need to remove it from that one.
